description: Shared fixture of composition rule theme-erc-v1 (platform v8 X, lane XCOMB): read by atx-impl/tests/strategy_ic_theme_erc_test.cpp (ThemeErcV1.SharedFixtureFractions) and atx-impl/tools/test_composition_theme_erc.py (test_shared_fixture_fractions). Three themes; the covariance (recorded in the order quality, value, momentum, unlike the members' first appearance value, momentum, quality) is built so that the equal risk contribution shares are exactly value 1/2, momentum 1/3, quality 1/6: with b = (1/2, 1/3, 1/6) over (value, momentum, quality) and off-diagonals 1, -1, 2, the diagonal solves b_t (C b)_t = 1 (11/3, 13/2, 35). Weights before the cap a_k * b_t; the cap 1/(2T) = 1/6 binds on value_a (1/5): its excess 1/30 goes to the momentum and quality members pro rata (x 16/15), one pass. Numbers are [numerator, denominator] pairs.
